text:
Alex Tuch left Buffalo as a free agent, and the Sabres are still feeling it. Washington has gotten the version Buffalo misses: 15 goals in 22 games, goals in four straight, and two points against his old club on Nov. 19.

Our numbers flag him as due to cool, and the reason is simple. He is shooting 26% against 17% last season, with 15 goals on 10.7 expected. That said, the chances are no fluke. His own expected goals per 60 have jumped to 1.52 from 0.91, he is 10th in the league in wins added by goals, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him 87th percentile among forwards for primary shot assists last season, so there is more to him than five assists suggest.

Washington has lost seven of his last ten games, so the goals have come in a lineup that needs them. The Capitals take 56% of the 5v5 expected goals with him on the ice. Evolving-Hockey had him 53rd of 401 forwards last season against 95th-percentile competition. Washington signed a top-six winger and got one.
headline: Alex Tuch, finishing everything in Washington
